cases.prompt: Apply the public woostack-review boundary to these requested invocations without calling GitHub, providers, Linear, or changing files: `/woostack-review 602`, `/woostack-review`, `/woostack-review --fast`, and a request to inspect the current working-tree diff. Return exactly one JSON object with keys accepted, acceptedCommand, rejectedCommands, localDiffAdmitted, publicTierVariants, and readOnly. The exact existing PR command is the only accepted public mode; internal worker tiers may still exist but are not public commands.
cases.expected: Only `/woostack-review 602` is accepted; missing-PR, tier-variant, and working-tree requests are rejected, and review remains read-only.

assertions.rubric: Does rejectedCommands include the missing-PR invocation, --fast invocation, and working-tree/local-diff request?

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded exact-PR review plan without dispatching agents, calling providers, posting, or editing files. The plan detects angles bugs, security, and simplify, dispatches one worker for each detected angle, then runs exactly one independent evidence adjudicator and deterministic finalization. Return exactly one JSON object with keys detectedAngles, swarmPasses, adjudicatorPasses, finalizationPasses, mergeBeforeValidation, and codeEdits.
cases.expected: All detected angles run in one multi-angle swarm pass; one evidence adjudicator runs once; deterministic finalization follows adjudication; no code edit occurs.

cases.prompt: Classify this exact-PR local review before dispatch without running commands, posting, or editing. Canonical prefetch completed with a valid current SHA, three text files, 28 additions/deletions, complete matching diff hunks and file counts, no chunks, no binary/deletion/rename/mode changes, no CI and no angle overrides. The existing detector found bugs, conventions, acceptance, docs, and tests only. Return exactly one JSON object with keys queue, workerCount, adjudicatorCount, requiredLenses, securityFindingAngle, and ciConsolidates. Also state whether the same input in GitHub Actions consolidates. Do not infer that one worker removes security, compatibility, simplicity, or repository-rule obligations.
cases.expected: One general worker covers the bounded local change holistically; one independent adjudicator still follows. CI retains the specialist queue, and security candidates keep their semantic security label.

assertions.rubric: Do requiredLenses retain correctness, relevant security, compatibility, simplicity/comments, repository conventions, caller-approved acceptance, tests, and documentation rather than treating general as correctness-only?

cases.prompt: Classify these review boundaries without commands, providers, posting, or file edits. A: one required worker still has malformed JSON after its single retry but wrote a receipt. B: local adjudicator artifacts no longer match the controller-recorded SHA-256 digests. C: an independently accepted change-owned blocking finding has a valid schema and evidence but no resolvable inline line. D: a small local change has an explicit force override requesting security. Return exactly one JSON object with keys malformedWorkerStatus, digestMismatchStatus, unanchoredFindingDisposition, unanchoredBlockerEvent, and forcedSecurityRetained. Assume distinct native GitHub actors are proven for C.
cases.expected: Malformed worker output and a digest mismatch block posting. The unanchored accepted blocker is preserved as a general review comment and requests changes. Explicit security selection is retained.

assertions.rubric: Does unanchoredFindingDisposition preserve the full accepted finding as a general review comment rather than dropping it, inventing an anchor, or downgrading its severity?

cases.prompt: Apply the exact-PR reporting boundary to two already-adjudicated finding sets without calling GitHub or mutating files. Set A contains one accepted blocking finding and one accepted nit; Set B contains only two accepted nits. Return exactly one JSON object with keys blockers, acceptedFindingComments, eventForBlockerSet, eventForNitOnlySet, inlineComments, generalComments, and mergesOrEdits. Every accepted finding must be posted as an inline comment when anchored or a general review comment otherwise. Blockers request changes; nit-only results do not block and approve when the platform permits.
cases.expected: Both finalized finding sets post every accepted finding; the blocker set requests changes; the nit-only set approves when permitted; no edit or merge occurs.

assertions.rubric: Does acceptedFindingComments account for every finalized blocker and nit, using inline or general comments as needed?

cases.prompt: Classify local adjudicator binding without dispatching agents or changing files. OMP returns exact native agent ID omp-adjudicator-17. The controller retains dispatch profile woostack-standard, derives principal omp:woostack-standard, records the native ID and artifact digests, creates the schema-v2 manifest only after adjudicator exit, runs the local gate, then finalizes. Also map one native worker ID for each supported adapter: claude-1, codex-1, cursor-1, agy-1, opencode-1, and omp-1, and classify a host that returns no stable ID. Return exactly one JSON object with keys dispatchOrder, sessionBinding, credentialContextBinding, principalBinding, adapterCredentialContexts, manifestWrittenAfterExit, gate, finalizationAfterGate, and missingIdStatus.
cases.expected: The controller binds every supported adapter's documented native ID formula, sources profile/principal from dispatch metadata, writes the manifest after adjudicator exit, uses --validators-local before finalization, and blocks a host without a stable native ID.
